FAQ
 
 
  Is Numu free to use?     
 Yes — nomu has no subscriptions, no ads, and no in-app purchases. It's built as a focused side project with a clear philosophy: your growth, your data, your pace. 
 
 
  How is Numu different from other habit trackers?     
 Most habit apps require an account, store your data in their cloud, and charge a monthly fee. nomu is local-first and offline by default — your data lives on your device, you don't need an account, and there are no ads or trackers. 
 
 
  When will Numu be available?     
 We're putting the finishing touches on nomu. Sign up for early access to be among the first to try it! 
 
 
  Can I track any type of habit?     
 Yes — daily habits like exercise and reading, weekly goals like meal prep, custom-frequency habits, long-term goals linked to the habits that drive them, tasks, and even prayer / fasting tracking. 
 
 
  What about Health and Islamic modules?     
 Both are first-class modules. Health covers water, sleep, weight, and food logging (workout tracking is on the roadmap). Islamic covers prayer tracking with scoring, fasting, and nafila (voluntary) tracking. 
 
 
  What languages are supported?     
 Arabic and English are supported out of the box, with RTL-aware layouts. The feature-first architecture makes adding additional languages straightforward.
